provider_errors: Failed to authenticate: OAuth token revoked. Please log in again or contact your administrator.
summary.recovery_action: Claude Code rejected repo-ai's dedicated login (expired or revoked; `claude auth status` checks only locally and can still report it as logged in). Log in again once with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.local/share/repo-ai/claude-provider claude auth login`, then start a new mission; retrying will fail the same way. Or switch provider via handoff --to <provider> and continue with do --from-handoff <capsule.json>
